assets.title: Quiet countryside rain
assets.description: Fine continuous natural rainfall, with small irregular droplets and a steady background.
assets.author: EduFigueres
assets.sourceDescriptionSummary: The creator describes soft rain in the countryside. Upstream processing is not disclosed; this export adds no dynamic processing.

assets.title: Fuller countryside rain
assets.description: A fuller natural rain bed from a separate, non-overlapping passage of the same countryside recording.
assets.author: EduFigueres
assets.sourceDescriptionSummary: The creator describes soft rain in the countryside. This is a different passage, not a second field recording. Upstream processing is not disclosed; this export adds no dynamic processing.

assets.title: Close garden cricket
assets.description: Clear close cricket pulses from a garden at night, with quiet spaces between calls.
assets.author: Vrymaa
assets.sourceDescriptionSummary: The creator describes close, clean crickets in a garden at night, without added reverb or echo. The original is mono.

assets.title: Summer garden crickets
assets.description: A separate summer-night cricket recording with a different call pattern and stereo space.
assets.author: Defelozedd94
assets.sourceDescriptionSummary: Summer-night garden crickets recorded with a Tascam DR-05; the creator removed storm background noise in Audacity. This new 40-second passage is independent from the legacy 8–28-second excerpt.

assets.title: Distant summer chorus
assets.description: Soft distant cricket layers with a wider, denser natural chorus behind the nearby calls.
assets.author: Speziax
assets.sourceDescriptionSummary: The creator describes distant crickets on a quiet summer night and reports only approximately +6.3 dB original gain, without other processing.

selectionNotes.rain-barkenov: CC0 #640655 was downloaded and inspected but not selected: sparse high-crest drop impacts conflict with a steady soft rain bed.
selectionNotes.cricket-mid-owlstorm: CC0 #320145 was downloaded and inspected but not selected: large broadband/low-frequency bursts and slower tonal sweeps conflict with the cleaner layered cricket direction.
selectionNotes.scope: Source-page evidence, waveform/spectrogram inspection, complete decoding, and envelope measurements support selection. No claim of human listening certification or automatic identification of every background sound is made.
